name: Customer Support — Account Management 23ffrtg
rubric:
You are evaluating customer support responses for account management scenarios: sign-in and access issues, shipping address management, and personal information updates.

Context & Policies:
Password requirements: 8+ characters, 1 number, 1 special character
Password reset: link sent to registered email, valid 1 hour
Account lockout: 5 failed attempts locks for 30 minutes
2FA optional but recommended; SMS or authenticator app
Never ask for passwords, full card numbers, or CVV
Addresses: save up to 10, one primary, system validates format
Pending-order address changes: possible only if not yet shipped
Cannot delete address tied to pending orders (archive instead)
APO/FPO supported with special formatting
Email changes: require verification of both old and new addresses; link valid short window
Name changes: 24 hours to propagate; may affect billing (must match payment method)
Username cannot be changed after creation
Date of birth: max 3 changes (fraud prevention)
Profile photo: JPG/PNG, max 5MB

anchors.input: Hi! I just got married and changed my last name. I need to update it on my account from Sarah Johnson to Sarah Martinez. Will this affect my orders?
anchors.response: Congratulations, Sarah! Happy to help you update that. You can change your name under Account Settings → Personal Information → Edit Name. Two things worth knowing before you save: first, the name change takes about 24 hours to propagate across our systems, so shipping labels on any orders placed today might still show Johnson. Second, your billing name needs to match the name on your payment method — if your cards are still under Johnson, keep the billing name as Johnson for now (you can update that field separately once your cards are reissued). Any existing orders already in processing will ship under the name on the order at time of purchase, so those aren't affected. Want me to walk you through anything else?
anchors.reasoning: Correctness: accurate on 24-hour propagation and billing-name-must-match-payment rules. Safety: warm tone matching a positive life event, no intrusive verification asks. Helpfulness: specific navigation path, anticipates the billing-mismatch pitfall before it happens. Completeness: covers the update path, the two impacts (timing, billing), behavior of existing orders, and invites follow-up.
anchors.reference: Congratulations, Sarah! Happy to help you update that. You can change your name under Account Settings → Personal Information → Edit Name. Two things worth knowing before you save: first, the change takes about 24 hours to propagate across our systems, so shipping labels on any orders placed today might still show Johnson. Second, your billing name needs to match the name on your payment method — if your cards are still under Johnson, leave the billing name as Johnson for now and update that field separately once your cards are reissued. Any orders already in processing will ship under the name they had at the time of purchase, so those aren't affected. Anything else I can help you with?

anchors.input: I just placed order #77234 but realized I put the wrong address! I need to change it to my office address ASAP. Order status says 'processing' - can you update it?
anchors.response: No problem! Unfortunately once an order is placed, the shipping address is locked in and can't be changed. You'll need to wait for it to arrive at the original address and then forward it, or refuse delivery so it comes back to us for a refund.
anchors.reasoning: Correctness failure: directly contradicts policy. Address changes ARE possible while order is in 'processing' status — the response treats all post-placement orders as locked, which is wrong and costs the customer the easy fix. Helpfulness also fails: pushes the customer toward expensive/slow workarounds (forwarding, refusal) when the direct solution is available.
anchors.reference: Good news — since order #77234 is still in 'processing' and hasn't shipped yet, we can update the shipping address. You can change it yourself under Order History → #77234 → Edit Shipping Address, or I can update it to your office address for you right now if you confirm the full address. One heads-up: if the order flips to 'shipped' before the change saves, we'd switch to a fallback like a carrier intercept or refusing delivery for a refund — but at the processing stage the direct edit should go through fine. Would you like me to make the change for you?
